title: Rebase: keep weighted token formula (condense 4 stats into 1)
description:
Decision 2 of the dev_fb_2 → master (v0.19.0) rebase.

KEEP fork formula from 933f4f7: Math.round(3*output + input + 0.2*cacheRead + cacheWrite) — intent is to condense the four token stats into one number with correct weights per stat (output ~3x, cacheRead ~0.2x).

Consequences vs master:
- Master's getLifetimeTotal (plain in+out+cacheWrite, deliberately excludes cacheRead, see issue #38 rationale in usage.ts) is replaced by the weighted score on all display surfaces.
- Reconcile with master's optional-typing LifetimeUsage {cacheRead?, cost?} (#243): cost stays a plain sum reported separately via getLifetimeCost/spend reporting; only the token DISPLAY total becomes weighted.
- Re-seat accumulation of cacheRead+cost from 931b367 onto master's LifetimeUsage shape.
- Update usage.ts comments so the weighting rationale replaces/extends the #38 exclusion note.

comments.author: assistant
comments.text: DECISION (user): keep weighted formula. Intent: condense the four token stats into one number giving correct weights per stat. Cost remains separate plain sum.

title: Remove foreground execution mode entirely (background-only spawns)
description:
Prep task for Decision 3 (tool-description overhaul). Subagents ALWAYS run in background; the blocking/foreground path goes away.

Touchpoints on master v0.19.0:
- Agent tool schema: drop `run_in_background` param (no false value left to select); renderCall/renderResult foreground-streaming branch removal
- src/index.ts: foreground execution branch (streaming via onUpdate), 'blocks until finished' wording in resume/run_in_background descriptions
- invocation-config.ts: runInBackground resolution + resolveJoinMode simplification
- agent-manager.ts: maxConcurrentForeground setting (#260) becomes dead — remove setting, menu entry, sanitize, docs
- settings.ts/README: maxConcurrentForeground + any 'foreground' references
- Nested delegation + RPC paths: defaultRunInBackground opts collapse to true
- Tests: foreground-concurrency*, foreground-result-retrieval, print-mode foreground e2e suites
Synergy: d819b9a (wait param removed), 70ed0e4 (anti-poll), 614c4ef (status:running) already assume a background-only world.

title: Audit + fix fork tool descriptions against v0.19.0 facts, then port fork style
description:
Prep + execution for Decision 3. Rationale kept: reduce context bloat; agent pulls more info on demand (agent_info). Keep fork style.

AUDIT FINDINGS (fork texts vs master v0.19.0):
1. OUTDATED: 'Foreground calls run sequentially' guidance assumes foreground default — moot after foreground removal (tintinweb-pi-subagents-1r7); delete/reword.
2. MISSING: name:/@handle addressing (#227) absent from all fork description surfaces; add one guideline line (address running agents via @name / steer_subagent).
3. MISSING: scheduleGuideline placeholder dropped from fork fullAgentToolDescription — scheduling feature undocumented there; re-add interpolated line.
4. MISSING: get_subagent_result never mentioned in fork full desc (only notification guidance); add pointer for retrieving full results.
5. CONDITIONAL: worktree/isolation wording depends on Decision 5 (keep master param vs frontmatter-only).
6. CHECK: compact mode = MUST call agent_info('list') first + notes block; ensure notes match post-decision schema (wait param gone, status:running present, overrides wording from a63e0ef).
7. prompts/agents-guidelines.md + examples/agent-tool-description.md: same pass (background-only, no foreground lines, @handle, schedule).
8. agent_info 'create' text: reconcile with final frontmatter field set after Decisions 1/5/7.

Then port fork descriptions (guidelines-style full desc, lean compact default, agent_info flow) with the corrected content onto master's 3-mode plumbing (mode selection logic stays master's unless user says otherwise).

title: Rebase: keep removal of get_subagent_result wait param; purge references
description:

KEEP fork behavior from d819b9a: no wait param on get_subagent_result — agents abused it to poll instead of waiting for completion notifications.

Purge master references accordingly:

- resultConsumed/cancelNudge interplay: re-check pre-marked flag logic tied to wait path
- Tests: test/wait-queued.test.ts and any wait:true coverage
- README/docs mentions of wait:true
Consistent with background-only spawns (tintinweb-pi-subagents-1r7): notification-driven flow only.

title: Add permanent lifetime stats store (accumulate on eviction, show in /agents menu)
description:
Decision 6 of the dev_fb_2 → master (v0.19.0) rebase.

KEEP master's eviction/tombstone workflow untouched (removeRecord, tombstones, clearCompleted, @handle reopen). Do NOT keep records after cleanup (drop 4600cac approach).

NEW: a global, permanent stats accumulator, small memory footprint (a handful of numbers), so subagent work done is understandable over time.

Spec:
- Hook: fold a departing record's stats into the store in removeRecord (single funnel for cleanup timer + clearCompleted evictions). Optionally also on dispose().
- Fields per record: lifetimeUsage {input, output, cacheWrite, cacheRead, cost}, toolUses, durationMs, run count.
- Display: /agents menu — 'Session total' (existing fd1e0c4, session-scoped) stays; add an 'All-time total' line from the permanent store (weighted token formula per Decision 2, cost via formatCost).
- Widget/viewer optionally show store totals later.

FLAGGED SUB-QUESTION (apply time, or answer now): 'permanent' = (a) in-memory module-level accumulator surviving /new and agent cleanup for the pi process lifetime, or (b) file-backed (e.g. .pi/agents-stats.json) surviving pi restarts. Default plan: (a) in-memory — matches 'small memory footprint'; upgrade path to (b) is a serialization wrapper. See REBASE-NOTES.md inventory #16 (4600cac).

comments.author: assistant
comments.text: DECISION (user): master added new features here — don't touch them. Instead: permanent global stats store (small footprint) accumulating subagent work, visible in /agents menu. Sub-question flagged: in-memory vs file-backed 'permanent'.
